tables.title: TABLE VI. - OVERALL PERFORMANCE FOR STAGE 53 (a) 70 Percent of design speed
tables.notes: Readings 3027, 3028, 3029, 3030, 3031. Printed with parameters as rows and the first row 'READING NUMBER' (dot leaders dropped); the CSV puts the reading numbers in the header row, first header cell 'Parameters'. Columns in printed order (high to low flow). No units printed (row 2 blank); appendix C: WT FLOW = equivalent weight flow, kg/sec; per-area flows kg/(sec)(m2); ROTATIVE SPEED rpm. Rendered at 300-600 dpi, second read from the image. Checks: efficiencies from the pressure and temperature ratios, annulus/frontal and orifice/frontal flow ratios, rotative speed/percent speed, head-rise coefficient scaled by speed squared; all pass. Rotor efficiencies above 1 at 70-90 percent speed are printed so and agree with the printed ratios.

tables.title: TABLE VII. - Continued. (r) 100 Percent of design speed; reading 3017
tables.notes: Page heading prints only 'TABLE VII. - Continued.'; the table is the blade-element data for rotor 53 (Table VII heading on its first page). Four printed blocks joined side by side on RP; headings = printed group heading + sub-heading. Only RP 1-9 printed (no TIP/HUB rows). No units row printed (row 2 blank); appendix C units. Numbers kept as printed. Read cell by cell from 300-dpi strips of a 600-dpi render, faint cells at 600 dpi; pdftotext layer not used for numbers. Checks: velocity triangles, Mach-number ratios, MERID VEL R, EFF from the pressure and temperature ratios, U/r against the Table VI rotative speed; blade angles implied by INCIDENCE/DEV agree across the six readings; rotor outlet = stator inlet total pressure and temperature. See notes.md.
